name: migrate-gemini-provider-to-antigravity-cli
title: Migrate the gemini provider to the Antigravity CLI (agy); usage recorded as unavailable
description: Google's Gemini CLI semantics are deprecated in favor of the Antigravity CLI (command `agy`). Hard-rename the in-tree `gemini` provider to `antigravity` (binary gemini->agy, print-mode interface), and DELETE the now-dead Gemini-API usage adapter. agy's CLI surface does NOT expose per-call token usage (verified by probe), so antigravity dispatch records usage as source=unavailable — no token inference, no raw transcript surfaced.
